# Local UI libraries

These files are served locally so the shared layout and charts remain available when a CDN is slow or unreachable.

| Library | Version | Source | License file |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bootstrap (CSS and bundle) | 5.3.3 | https://www.npmjs.com/package/bootstrap/v/5.3.3 | ../../css/vendor/LICENSE-bootstrap.txt |
| Bootstrap Icons (CSS and fonts) | 1.11.3 | https://www.npmjs.com/package/bootstrap-icons/v/1.11.3 | ../../css/vendor/LICENSE-bootstrap-icons.txt |
| Chart.js (UMD) | 4.4.1 | https://www.npmjs.com/package/chart.js/v/4.4.1 | LICENSE-chartjs.txt |

Bootstrap and Bootstrap Icons keep the versions used by the original shared layouts. Both charts use the dashboard's existing Chart.js version.
